faq.question: What are the eligibility requirements and prerequisites for the AI Digital Marketing Strategist program?
faq.answer: The program requires basic computer literacy, internet navigation skills, and familiarity with spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel). No prior programming experience, marketing degree, or commercial advertising background is required. The curriculum begins with business fundamentals before progressing into advanced paid media, analytics, and automation.

faq.question: How does the beginner-to-advanced learning pathway work over the 6 months?
faq.answer: The 6-month journey is divided into sequential phases: Month 1 focuses on business strategy, unit economics, and consumer psychology; Month 2 advances into semantic SEO, technical site crawls, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO); Month 3 covers brand systems, organic social operations, and Google Ads; Month 4 tackles Meta Ads, creative testing matrices, and GTM/GA4 analytics; Month 5 masters conversion rate optimization, HubSpot CRM, and n8n automation; and Month 6 is dedicated to media budgeting, agency operations, the comprehensive 90-day capstone project, and individual viva voce defense.

faq.question: What is the total duration and guided training hour commitment?
faq.answer: The program comprises exactly 240 guided instructional and laboratory training hours delivered over 6 calendar months across 11 structured modules (53 detailed lessons). In addition to guided class and lab time, students should expect to commit 6–8 hours per week to independent laboratory builds, tool configuration, and portfolio artifact development.

faq.question: What software tools and platforms will I learn hands-on?
faq.answer: You will master 15 core production platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Search Console, Looker Studio, Semrush, Screaming Frog SEO Spider, HubSpot CRM, n8n, Brevo, WordPress, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Canva. Supporting exposure includes Ahrefs, Microsoft Clarity, Meta Business Suite, Claude, Notion, and Adobe Firefly.

faq.question: How are modern AI tools integrated into the curriculum?
faq.answer: Artificial intelligence is taught as an operational accelerator with strict human-in-the-loop governance across all modules. You will learn enterprise prompt engineering (Role, Task, Context, Constraints), customer review mining, multi-angle copywriting, generative visual ideation, and conversational search evaluation (GEO for AI Overviews). We strictly emphasize fact-checking, hallucination mitigation, and copyright compliance, without promoting unverified autonomous spam.

faq.question: What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and how is it taught?
faq.answer: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) focuses on understanding how modern conversational answer engines—such as Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Gemini—synthesize search results. You will learn entity mapping, structured data markup, and information gain principles to measure and improve brand citation presence. We teach realistic measurement methodologies without making unscientific promises of guaranteed AI citations.

faq.question: Do I need to spend my own money on paid advertising campaigns?
faq.answer: No. Nova Skills enforces a strict Zero-Student-Ad-Spend Policy. All advertising practicals in Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager are conducted in professional expert draft modes, sandbox accounts, and offline campaign builders (such as Google Ads Editor). You will build complete production-ready campaigns, targeting hierarchies, and creative matrices without risking personal financial capital.

faq.question: How are analytics, GTM conversion tracking, and attribution handled?
faq.answer: You will work with authorized sandbox websites, Google Tag Manager containers, and live Google Analytics 4 demo properties (such as the Google Merchandise Store). You will deploy custom event tags, verify triggers in Tag Assistant Preview mode, designate commercial Key Events, configure exploration funnels, and build interactive multi-channel Looker Studio dashboards calculating blended CPA and ROAS.

faq.question: What will I learn about CRM, lifecycle marketing, and marketing automation?
faq.answer: You will configure real CRM pipelines in HubSpot CRM, design 100-point behavioral lead scoring models, build automated email nurture sequences in Brevo, and construct no-code automation workflows in n8n connecting website form webhooks to CRM contact creation and notifications, complete with error-handling logic.

faq.question: What portfolio projects and capstone deliverable will I complete?
faq.answer: You will build 7 modular portfolio projects (SEO/GEO audit, brand content strategy, Google Ads plan, Meta Ads testing matrix, GTM/Looker Studio dashboard, CRM automation engine, and landing page CRO audit) plus a comprehensive 14-deliverable final capstone: a complete 90-Day Integrated Business Growth Strategy. You will also complete a timed technical troubleshooting laboratory exam and defend your work in an oral viva voce defense.

All student case studies are clearly documented with verified data inputs, ensuring total transparency and academic integrity.

lessons.lesson_title: A/B Split Testing Methodology & Statistical Significance
lessons.what_is_taught: A/B split testing principles, hypothesis formulation (If/Then/Because), sample size calculation, statistical significance (p-value, 95% confidence threshold), experiment prioritization (ICE/PIE), and post-test reporting.
subtopics: A/B testing methodology: control vs. variant, isolated single-variable tests vs. radical redesigns

lessons.lesson_title: Capstone Project Scoping & Client Discovery Brief
lessons.what_is_taught: Selecting a capstone client enterprise, conducting comprehensive business and competitor research, defining target audience segments, and authoring an executive strategic discovery brief.
subtopics: Selecting and vetting a real business or complex simulated enterprise for the 90-day growth project
Conducting comprehensive market, competitor, and customer discovery research
Synthesizing two validated buyer persona dossiers and full-funnel customer journey maps
Establishing quantifiable commercial KPIs, target acquisition volumes, and payback timelines
Authoring an executive Strategic Discovery Brief for faculty panel approval
lessons.why_it_matters: A rigorous discovery foundation ensures that every downstream tactical asset addresses verified business objectives rather than arbitrary assumptions.
lessons.what_learner_does: Complete the capstone discovery phase, submitting a validated client profile, competitor intelligence matrix, and strategic brief for mentor review.
lessons.expected_outcome: Capstone Client Discovery Dossier & Strategic Foundation Brief.

lessons.lesson_title: Organic Search, GEO & Content Asset Compilation
lessons.what_is_taught: Executing a complete technical SEO audit, building an 8-page topical authority cluster map, generating LocalBusiness schema, and compiling a 30-day content calendar with production creative assets.
subtopics: Executing a 25-point technical SEO site crawl and compiling an engineering remediation roadmap
Architecting an 8-page topical authority cluster map with search intent and internal linking specifications
Generating and validating Schema.org LocalBusiness and Organization structured data markup
Compiling a 30-day multi-channel content calendar in Notion across Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube
Producing 5 production-grade creative assets: 1 social carousel, 1 short-form reel script, and 3 ad graphics
lessons.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the candidate's capability to build compounding organic search and social discovery assets without relying entirely on paid advertising.
lessons.what_learner_does: Compile all organic search, GEO, and content deliverables into the capstone portfolio dossier.
lessons.expected_outcome: Integrated Organic Search, GEO & Content Portfolio Package.

lessons.lesson_title: Paid Acquisition Architecture & Landing Page Funnel Build
lessons.what_is_taught: Structuring Google Search and PMax campaigns, building Meta acquisition and retargeting campaigns in draft mode, and engineering a live conversion landing page in WordPress.
subtopics: Structuring a high-intent Google Search campaign blueprint with STAGs, RSA copy, and negative keyword lists
Specifying a Performance Max (PMax) asset group with 20 visual assets and audience signals
Configuring a Meta full-funnel advertising campaign in draft mode with a 3×3 creative testing matrix
Building a native Meta Higher-Intent Instant Lead Form with qualifying questions
Publishing a live responsive conversion landing page in WordPress with trust signals and lead capture form
lessons.why_it_matters: Integrates paid search, paid social, and conversion architecture into a synchronized customer acquisition funnel capable of scaling profitably.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build and document all paid advertising campaign structures, creative matrices, and the live WordPress campaign landing page.
lessons.expected_outcome: Paid Multi-Channel Acquisition Architecture & Live Landing Page Funnel.

lessons.lesson_title: Measurement Tagging, GA4 Tracking & Dashboard Integration
lessons.what_is_taught: Deploying GTM container tags, verifying GA4 Key Events, establishing CRM lifecycle pipelines in HubSpot, designing Brevo email nurture workflows, and building an executive Looker Studio dashboard.
subtopics: Deploying and verifying custom GA4 tracking tags (form submit, button click) in Google Tag Manager
Designating GA4 Key Events and configuring custom exploration drop-off funnels
Configuring HubSpot CRM deal stages, contact properties, and lead qualification rules
Building an automated 5-stage email nurture workflow in Brevo with conditional branching
Connecting data sources and building an interactive executive marketing dashboard in Looker Studio
lessons.why_it_matters: Proves the student's mastery in establishing closed-loop measurement, connecting front-end marketing clicks to back-end CRM revenue.
lessons.what_learner_does: Complete the full technical measurement and lifecycle automation build, verifying all data flows across GTM, GA4, HubSpot, Brevo, and Looker Studio.
lessons.expected_outcome: Closed-Loop Measurement Architecture & Live Executive Looker Studio Dashboard.

lessons.lesson_title: Practical Technical Troubleshooting Examination
lessons.what_is_taught: Timed laboratory troubleshooting examination diagnosing and fixing simulated marketing emergencies: broken tracking tags, attribution discrepancies, campaign dis-approvals, and automation errors.
subtopics: Diagnosing broken tracking containers: identifying un-triggered tags and malformed dataLayer variables in GTM
Resolving GA4 data discrepancies: unassigned traffic channels, missing UTM parameters, and duplicate events
Fixing Google Ads and Meta Ads policy violations: editorial flags, destination mismatch, and ad disapprovals
Debugging n8n automation failures: failed webhook payloads, rate limit errors, and data mapping mismatches
Under-pressure commercial problem-solving and rapid-response technical documentation
lessons.why_it_matters: Real-world marketing leadership requires rapid, calm technical diagnosis when live campaigns break or tracking data fails during crucial sales periods.
lessons.what_learner_does: Complete a timed, hands-on technical troubleshooting examination resolving 4 injected system errors across tracking, advertising, and automation environments.
lessons.expected_outcome: Technical Troubleshooting Examination Scorecard & Remediation Report.

lessons.lesson_title: Final Capstone Portfolio Submission & Oral Viva Defense
lessons.what_is_taught: Compiling the final 90-Day Integrated Growth Strategy portfolio, presenting to an executive review panel, defending strategic budget allocations, and answering oral viva voce questions.
subtopics: Compiling the comprehensive 14-deliverable capstone portfolio into a polished client dossier
Structuring the 20-minute executive capstone presentation deck
Defending channel budget allocation, CAC payback assumptions, and revenue forecasts before faculty
Individual oral viva voce defense: answering rigorous technical questions across all 10 marketing disciplines
Post-assessment feedback, professional portfolio finalization, and career placement preparation
lessons.why_it_matters: Validates that the candidate possesses not merely theoretical knowledge, but true strategic mastery and the communication poise required of senior marketing strategists.
lessons.what_learner_does: Deliver the 20-minute executive presentation and successfully defend the capstone strategy in an individual 15-minute oral viva voce examination.
lessons.expected_outcome: Graduated Capstone Portfolio Dossier & Verified Viva Voce Assessment Certification.

curriculum_breakdown.hands_on_practice: Execute a complete 90-Day Integrated Business Growth Strategy comprising 14 core commercial deliverables, complete a timed technical troubleshooting examination, and successfully defend the strategy in an oral viva voce defense.

curriculum_breakdown.business_application: Serves as the definitive proof-of-competence portfolio asset for senior digital marketing strategist, growth lead, and agency director roles.
curriculum_breakdown.expected_outcome: Comprehensive enterprise-grade digital marketing portfolio and successful defense certification.

core_projects.business_brief: An established mid-market B2B software consultancy is experiencing declining organic search traffic due to algorithmic shifts and the rise of Google AI Overviews. The client requires a comprehensive market intelligence audit, competitor gap analysis, technical site crawl, and a 90-day SEO/GEO remediation roadmap to reclaim search market share.
core_projects.data_requirements: Exported GSC search queries, Screaming Frog site crawl CSV dataset (sandbox domain), and competitor SERP snapshots.
student_actions: Perform a 25-point technical SEO crawl evaluating HTTP status codes, canonical hygiene, internal linking, and Core Web Vitals.
Conduct semantic keyword research to build an 8-page topical authority cluster map with designated pillar and cluster URLs.
Generate and validate Schema.org LocalBusiness and Organization JSON-LD structured data.
Analyze brand visibility in Google AI Overviews and compile an evidence-based 90-day SEO/GEO improvement roadmap.
exact_deliverables: 25-point technical SEO crawl audit with prioritized engineering remediation tickets.
Topical authority cluster architecture map linking 30+ semantic keywords to target page URLs.
Validated Schema.org JSON-LD structured data script.
90-Day SEO/GEO Strategic Improvement Roadmap (PDF/Notion).
core_projects.evaluation_rubric: Technical accuracy of crawl diagnostics (30%), depth of topical cluster mapping (25%), valid JSON-LD schema syntax without errors (20%), and realism of the 90-day roadmap (25%).
core_projects.independent_evidence: Screaming Frog crawl export file, live Schema.org validator test URL, and documented Search Console performance queries.
core_projects.qa_requirements: Zero critical syntax errors in schema markup; 100% of mapped keywords must demonstrate verified commercial or informational search intent.
core_projects.reporting_requirements: Executive 4-page audit summary with priority-ranked technical recommendations and timeline milestones.

core_projects.business_brief: A direct-to-consumer sustainable lifestyle brand seeks to scale organic brand awareness and engagement across Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube Shorts. The student must establish cohesive brand guidelines, engineer a 30-day omnichannel editorial calendar, and produce production-ready creative assets.
core_projects.data_requirements: Brand audience demographic profiles, past top-performing organic post metrics, and competitor content benchmarks.
student_actions: Formulate a digital brand style guide establishing typography contrast, color psychology, and voice parameters.
Architect a 30-day multi-channel editorial calendar structured around 4 distinct content pillars.
Design a 7-slide educational carousel in Canva utilizing direct-response visual hierarchy and AIDA copywriting.
Script and storyboard a 45-second short-form video reel with timestamped hooks and on-screen caption cues.
exact_deliverables: Digital Brand Style Guide & Voice Playbook.
30-day multi-channel editorial calendar in Notion with copy briefs and publishing schedules.
Production-grade 7-slide social carousel asset suite (1080×1350px PNG).
45-second short-form video production script and storyboard with 3-second hook variations.
core_projects.evaluation_rubric: Visual hierarchy and brand consistency (30%), strategic alignment of content pillars with customer journey (30%), direct-response copywriting rigor (25%), and editorial calendar completeness (15%).
core_projects.independent_evidence: Live Notion calendar share link, downloadable Canva asset exports, and timestamped video script document.
core_projects.qa_requirements: All visual assets must comply with platform aspect ratio standards (1:1, 4:5, 9:16) and meet minimum text contrast accessibility standards.
core_projects.reporting_requirements: One-page content operations brief detailing publishing cadence, repurposing workflows, and monthly engagement KPIs.

core_projects.project_title: Google Ads Campaign Strategy and Optimization
core_projects.business_brief: A high-ticket commercial HVAC and facility services provider requires a scalable Google Ads acquisition system. The student must structure a high-intent Search campaign with negative keyword governance, engineer an asset-rich Responsive Search Ad (RSA) suite, and configure a Performance Max asset group in draft mode.
core_projects.data_requirements: Keyword Planner search volume curves, historical CPC estimates, client service catalogs, and geographic service radii.
student_actions: Structure a multi-tier Google Search campaign in draft mode utilizing Single-Theme Ad Groups (STAGs).
Develop an RSA copywriting matrix with 15 headlines and 4 descriptions with message match to landing page offers.
Compile a comprehensive 50-term negative keyword list to eliminate non-commercial query wastage.
Build a complete Performance Max (PMax) asset group specification with audience signals and text/image assets.
exact_deliverables: Google Ads Editor archive (.csv / .aeax) or structured campaign architecture spreadsheet.
RSA copywriting matrix with headline pinning rules and 4 sitelink extensions.
Tiered negative keyword library (account, campaign, and ad group levels).
PMax asset group blueprint detailing audience signals and creative asset dimensions.
core_projects.evaluation_rubric: Intent purity of keyword selection (25%), Ad Rank optimization through RSA diversity and asset extensions (25%), negative keyword coverage (25%), and bidding strategy economic logic (25%).
core_projects.independent_evidence: Exported campaign build file from Google Ads Editor and verification of zero active spend during sandbox build.
core_projects.qa_requirements: All headlines strictly within 30 characters; descriptions within 90 characters; sitelinks include valid descriptions; zero ad policy violations.
core_projects.reporting_requirements: Executive campaign strategy brief outlining projected CPCs, target CPAs, and budget pacing rules.

core_projects.business_brief: A boutique enterprise SaaS provider wants to generate qualified sales discovery calls. The student must architect an acquisition and retargeting paid social funnel in Meta Ads Manager, engineer a native Instant Lead Form with custom qualification filters, and execute a 3×3 creative testing matrix.
core_projects.data_requirements: Product feature briefs, customer case studies, ICP persona profiles, and target lead qualification criteria.
student_actions: Set up full-funnel campaign architecture in draft mode using ODAX Leads objectives.
Map audience architecture combining first-party Custom Audiences, Lookalike Audiences, and broad targeting.
Design a 3×3 creative testing suite (3 visual formats × 3 copy angles: Problem-Agitate-Solve, Social Proof, Benefit).
Configure a multi-step Higher-Intent Instant Lead Form with 2 custom qualifying screening questions.
exact_deliverables: Meta Ads Manager campaign export / configuration blueprint.
Complete 3×3 creative testing matrix with 9 formatted visual and copy variants.
Configured Meta Instant Lead Form specification with privacy policy and CRM routing map.
Creative fatigue diagnostic protocol and frequency monitoring rules.
core_projects.evaluation_rubric: Full-funnel campaign structure logic (25%), creative hook diversity in the 3×3 matrix (30%), qualification rigor of Instant Form fields (25%), and audience exclusion hygiene (20%).
core_projects.independent_evidence: Meta Ads Manager sandbox campaign screenshots/exports and high-resolution ad creative assets.
core_projects.qa_requirements: Zero audience overlap between prospecting and remarketing ad sets; lead form includes working privacy policy URL and explicit consent checkbox.
core_projects.reporting_requirements: Paid social media plan outlining testing methodology, kill-metrics for underperforming ads, and scaling thresholds.

The student must deploy a fresh Google Tag Manager container, configure custom event tracking, designate Key Events in GA4, and build an interactive multi-channel executive reporting dashboard in Looker Studio.

Validate tag firing, trigger conditions, and variable values in Tag Assistant Preview mode.
Configure GA4 custom dimensions, designate commercial Key Events, and build a custom Funnel Exploration.
Engineer an interactive single-page executive dashboard in Looker Studio connecting blended GA4 and search data.

Tag Assistant QA verification log with DebugView event screenshots.
GA4 Multi-Step Funnel Exploration drop-off report.

Build a 100-point numerical lead scoring model balancing explicit attributes and implicit engagement signals.
Author and deploy a 5-stage automated lifecycle email sequence in Brevo with conditional branching.
Construct an automated marketing workflow in n8n routing webhook payloads from forms to CRM and email tools.

100-Point Lead Scoring Matrix and MQL handoff routing rules.
5-stage automated email sequence copy deck and workflow diagram in Brevo.
Exported n8n automation workflow JSON file with webhook listener and error-handling branch.

core_projects.project_title: Landing Page CRO and Growth Experiments
core_projects.business_brief: An online education portal is driving substantial traffic to its registration page, but conversion rates remain stubbornly below 2%. The student must conduct a behavioral UX audit using Microsoft Clarity, apply the LIFT heuristic model to identify friction points, publish an optimized landing page in WordPress, and formulate an ICE-prioritized A/B testing roadmap.
core_projects.data_requirements: Microsoft Clarity session recordings and heatmaps, landing page analytics, and user drop-off metrics.
student_actions: Perform a heuristic evaluation using the 6-factor LIFT Model (Value Proposition, Relevance, Clarity, Urgency, Anxiety, Distraction).
Audit 10 session recordings and 3 heatmaps in Microsoft Clarity to pinpoint rage-clicks and drop-off friction.
Build and publish a responsive, conversion-optimized campaign landing page in WordPress with trust architecture.
Formulate 3 rigorous A/B test hypotheses with sample size calculations and rank them using the ICE prioritization framework.
exact_deliverables: Heuristic LIFT Model Landing Page Evaluation Dossier.
Microsoft Clarity behavioral UX heatmap diagnostic report.
Live responsive WordPress campaign landing page URL.
ICE-prioritized A/B testing experimentation backlog with statistical sample size models.
core_projects.evaluation_rubric: Depth of heuristic friction diagnosis (25%), behavioral heatmap data interpretation (25%), quality and responsiveness of WordPress landing page (25%), and statistical rigor of A/B test hypotheses (25%).
core_projects.independent_evidence: Live WordPress page URL, Clarity heatmap screenshots with timestamped observations, and ICE scoring spreadsheet.
core_projects.qa_requirements: Landing page loads in under 2.5 seconds on mobile; zero broken interactive elements; clear single primary call-to-action above the fold.
core_projects.reporting_requirements: Executive CRO audit report presenting conversion bottlenecks and forecasted conversion uplift from prioritized experiments.
